verdict.rationale: A managed analytical database could plausibly ship natural-language querying over a semantic layer, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack shows no such capability. The MCP server (docs-7) only gives coding agents raw tools to list services and run SQL, which is a developer building block rather than governed, semantically grounded answers for business users. Table- and column-level roles (docs-24) and third-party BI compatibility (docs-8) are adjacent features and earn no credit.
